rules.name: Cluck - Calculate bird age from hatch date
rules.logic_summary: Calculates age in days from the hatched date and updates the sex to hen or rooster if older than 20 weeks.

rules.name: Cluck - Adjust flock head count when bird status changes
rules.logic_summary: Decreases flock head count if bird status changes to deceased, processed, escaped, or retired.

rules.name: Cluck - Compute egg production rate
rules.logic_summary: Calculates and stores the egg production rate based on the flock size and collected eggs.

rules.name: Cluck - Auto-open feed reorder task
rules.logic_summary: Creates a reorder incident if feed stock drops below reorder threshold.

rules.name: Cluck - Calculate order total
rules.logic_summary: Computes order subtotal and total cost based on items ordered.

rules.name: Cluck - Award loyalty eggs on fulfillment
rules.logic_summary: Awards loyalty points based on the total order value after fulfillment.

rules.name: Cluck - Escalate critical incidents
rules.logic_summary: Adjusts priority and urgency if incident is marked as critical.
